class.name: GodotDoctorRunner
class.brief_description: A base class for a runner that executes a set of validations for Godot Doctor.

method.name: _init
method.description: Initializes the runner with [param validator]. Exits with failure if [param validator] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: run
method.description: Kicks off the validation run for this runner.

method.name: _run
method.description: Implements the logic for running validations for this runner.

members.member: The validator responsible for running validations and collecting results for this runner.

signal.name: started_scene_collection
signal.description: Emitted when starting collection of validation results for a set of scenes.

signal.name: finished_scene_collection
signal.description: Emitted when finishing collection of validation results for a set of scenes.

signal.name: started_node_collection
signal.description: Emitted when starting collection of validation results for a set of nodes.

signal.name: finished_node_collection
signal.description: Emitted when finishing collection of validation results for a set of nodes.

signal.name: started_resource_collection
signal.description: Emitted when starting collection of validation results for a set of resources.

signal.name: finished_resource_collection
signal.description: Emitted when finishing collection of validation results for a set of resources.

signal.name: started_run_for_scene_res_path
signal.description: Emitted when starting validation for a scene at [param scene_res_path]. This runs just before [GodotDoctorValidator] runs validation for a scene. Will [b]not[/b] be emitted if the scene fails to load, so listeners can rely on this signal to only receive paths of scenes that were successfully loaded.

signal.name: finished_run_for_scene_res_path
signal.description: Emitted when finishing validation for a scene at [param scene_res_path].

signal.name: started_run_for_resource
signal.description: Emitted when starting validation for [param resource].

signal.name: finished_run_for_resource
signal.description: Emitted when finishing validation for a resource at [param resource_res_path].

signal.name: run_complete
signal.description: Emitted when the entire run is complete, after all scenes and resources have been validated.
